title: GGUF 头解析：magic / version / 张量与元数据数
expected_output:
magic: GGUF
version: 3
tensors: 16 kv: 4
头大小(字节): 16
code:
def parse_gguf(header):
    magic = header[:4]
    version = int.from_bytes(header[4:8], "little")
    n_tensors = int.from_bytes(header[8:12], "little")
    n_kv = int.from_bytes(header[12:16], "little")
    return {"magic": magic.decode(), "version": version,
            "n_tensors": n_tensors, "n_kv": n_kv}

raw = b"GGUF" + (3).to_bytes(4,"little") + (16).to_bytes(4,"little") + (4).to_bytes(4,"little")
meta = parse_gguf(raw)
print("magic:", meta["magic"])
print("version:", meta["version"])
print("tensors:", meta["n_tensors"], "kv:", meta["n_kv"])
print("头大小(字节):", len(raw))
